title: arenaria boissieri
intro: Arenaria boissieri, commonly known as Boissier's sandwort, is a plant species in the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). It is a low-growing, perennial herb with medicinal properties. Arenaria boissieri has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as wound healing, antiseptic, and antiviral properties.
